## Hypothesis

The shotgun scalper stage2 parameter sweep aimed to find relaxed-gate combinations that improve wide P&L while maintaining a focus on winning regions. The top keeper shows high wide P&L ($15,706.5) but negative edge capture (-$36.0) on J's source-of-truth days, indicating it captures no winners and adds losses on loser days. This suggests the strategy is overfit to non-J days and fails to replicate J's edge.

## Mechanism

Enter on shotgun scalper signals with the following parameters:
- tp_premium_pct: 0.5 (exit 1/3 of position at +50% premium gain)
- stop_premium_pct: -0.3 (catastrophe stop at -30% premium loss)
- time_stop_min: 10 (exit after 10 minutes if no other exit)
- strike_offset: 2 (ITM-2 strikes)
- chandelier_arm_pct: 0.5 (profit lock arms at +50% gain, trails 50% from HWM)
- vol_ratio_threshold: 1.2 (require volume > 1.2x 20-bar average)
Exit logic: first of TP1, stop, time stop, or chandelier profit-lock triggers.

2. **Sample bias:** by_day covers only 3 loser days (5/05, 5/06, 5/07) with zero winner days; wide P&L derived from 1,279 trades (likely non-J days). High overfit risk as strategy loses on J loser days and captures zero J winners.
